_comment: THE canonical version-matrix construct catalogue (VERSION_TEST_MATRIX_DESIGN.md §10 #5). Each entry: a minimal program exercising ONE construct + its edition metadata. VersionMatrixTests computes the expected outcome per (construct × edition): compiles iff introducedIn <= V and (removedIn null or V < removedIn). The human-readable VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md and the (future) in-code ConstructDialectStatus registry are renderings of THIS file — extend it here, never fork. 'vcr' cites the VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE row/section or the introducing standard where the doc has no row (it covers 2002→2023 deltas only).

constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. NUC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC X(5) VALUE "HI".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE "BYE" TO W.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: READ ... PREVIOUS (keyed sequential read in reverse), ISO §14.9.30 Format 1 — introduced 2002
constructs.vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard); rows 29/108 gate the after-OPEN behavior
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RP.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrp" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS W-K.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-K PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O F.
    READ F PREVIOUS AT END DISPLAY "E".
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SF.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmsf" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS W-K.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-K PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O F.
    START F FIRST INVALID KEY DISPLAY "E".
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: DELETE FILE (physical file deletion), ISO 2023 §14.9.10 Format 2
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. DF.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "f.dat" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DELETE FILE F.
    STOP RUN.

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. AL.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 P USAGE POINTER.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    ALLOCATE 100 CHARACTERS RETURNING P.
    STOP RUN.

PROGRAM-ID. FR.
DATA DIVISION.

77 P USAGE POINTER.

DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

constructs.description: GOBACK RETURNING status, ISO §14.9.18 — the RETURNING phrase is 2002+
constructs.source:

PROGRAM-ID. GR.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 RC PIC 99 VALUE 7.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    GOBACK RETURNING RC.

constructs.description: STOP RUN WITH status phrase, ISO §14.9.42 — the status phrase is 2002+
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SR.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 RC PIC 99 VALUE 3.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.

constructs.description: BASED clause (a data item addressed via SET ADDRESS/ALLOCATE), ISO §13.18.5 — introduced 2002
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BA.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 B BASED.
   05 F PIC X(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: PROCEDURE DIVISION … RETURNING, ISO §14.2 — the RETURNING phrase is 2002+
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PR.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
77 RC PIC 99.
PROCEDURE DIVISION RETURNING RC.
MAIN.
    MOVE 9 TO RC.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: Fixed-point item wider than 18 digits (PIC 9(19)) — the 2002+ wide tier; COBOL-85 caps numeric items/literals at 18 digits (ISO §8.3.1.2, §13.18.40)
constructs.vcr: 85→2002 capacity change (derive from the 2002 standard; ISO §8.3.1.2 1..31-digit literals)
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. WIDE.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(19) VALUE 1234567890123456789.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: The OPTIONS paragraph with ARITHMETIC IS NATIVE — the OPTIONS paragraph is ISO 2014+ (§11.9)
constructs.vcr: 2014 introduction (the OPTIONS paragraph; derive from the 2014 standard)
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. OA.
OPTIONS.
    ARITHMETIC IS NATIVE.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(3) VALUE 5.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: The ROUNDED MODE IS phrase (the 8-mode set) — ISO 2014+ (§14.7.4); at 85/2002 bare ROUNDED is the single nearest-away-from-zero rounding
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RM.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9(3).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W ROUNDED MODE IS NEAREST-EVEN = 5 / 2.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: OPTIONS ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL (decimal128 intermediates, §8.8.1.5) — ISO 2014+
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SDPROG.
OPTIONS.
    ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD-DECIMAL.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC 9V9(5).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    COMPUTE W = 1 / 8.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: TYPE IS clause referencing a type declaration, ISO 2023 §13.18.58 (TYPEDEF family)
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. TY.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W TYPE IS WTYPE.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
